source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-17

procedures.title: Door lock and remote controls: remove and install
steps: After the lock mechanism is assembled, adjust the linkage by unclipping and turning the threaded rods until it works properly.

procedures.title: Outer door handle and lock cylinder: remove and install
steps: Removal: Take off the handle assembly by removing the 3 nuts holding its studs to the handle housing.
Take out the lock cylinder by removing the 2 screws at the top of the assembly.
Installation: Fit a new seal if needed.
Set the handle housing in place and install the handle assembly.
Check the door lock operation carefully.
notes: Parts shown in figure 39 in the manual.

procedures.title: Door hinges: remove and install
steps: Removal: Take off the door trim panel.
Remove the hinge access cover from the door inner panel.
notes: Parts shown in figure 40 in the manual.
